1\. Teardown stops after first error 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
Wrapping the entire callback loop in one _CollectErrors context causes an exception from any
teardown callback to exit the loop, so later callbacks never run. This breaks the stated behavior
that all application teardown callbacks execute before collected errors are raised.
